rule: Rehearsal inputs only. Every entry is an engineering PROPOSAL or a MEASURE_PLACEHOLDER awaiting measurement; none is approved or a production value. The resolver refuses an entry for a value that is already approved.

app_max_block_bytes.basis: The code maximum; the engine block bound is the same.

app_max_tx_bytes.basis: The code maximum; a root control needs three hex SLH-DSA signatures (178,752 bytes) plus its payload.

controller_shock_threshold_ppm.basis: Soft and hard gains are equal, so the threshold has no effect; this keeps every error in one regime.

controller_volatility_threshold_ppm.basis: Volatility is always 0 under observation contract v1, so damping never applies.

emergency_max_anchor_age_blocks.basis: One hour; set from measured propagation on staging.

emergency_max_validity_blocks.basis: One hour; set from measured multi-party signing on staging (E03, T02).

engine_evidence_max_bytes.basis: With 64 validators, about 767 KB of each block remains for transactions.

governance_max_governance_action_bytes.basis: Equal to the deposit bound, as the node requires.

handover_authority_threshold.basis: Three of five, like the other root groups.

handover_max_signatures.basis: The threshold; three hex signatures fit a transaction.

max_action_bytes.basis: Parameter changes and validator registry actions are small.

max_recorded_epochs.basis: One year of issuance journal (176 bytes an epoch).

max_voters.basis: At least the reward position bound.

ordinary_max_block_transaction_bytes.basis: Under the 1 MiB block; about 180 basic Sends.

ordinary_max_block_transaction_gas.basis: About a thousand basic Sends by gas; bytes and signature checks bind first.

ordinary_max_expiry_lifetime.basis: 20 minutes; 240 blocks of 200 signature checks stay within 65,536 retained receipts.

ordinary_max_transaction_gas.basis: Room above the 100,000 floor for staking and validator transactions that write shared state; the fee cap follows at the highest governed price.

ordinary_max_wire_bytes.basis: Its base64 transport (87,427 bytes) fits a transaction.

recovery_expiry_event_gas_cost.basis: Charged to the shared expiry counter, not to users.

recovery_mandatory_expiry_gas_budget.basis: One hundred expiry events a block at 10,000 gas each.

recovery_max_block_gas.basis: Ten maximal recovery transactions a block.

recovery_max_block_recovery_signatures.basis: Recovery is rare; bounds signature work a block.

recovery_max_due_expiry_events_per_heigh.basis: Equals the expiry budget divided by the event cost.

recovery_max_pending_accounts.basis: Accounts with a recovery in progress at once.

reward_max_positions.basis: The code maximum: concurrent staking owners.
